The full test suite is green: **32 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors**.

## Summary

I implemented the audit-on-create requirement in the owner creation endpoint (`POST /api/owners`), handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`.

**Changes to `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:**

1. Added a dedicated SLF4J logger named `AUDIT`:
   ```java
   private static final org.slf4j.Logger AUDIT = org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
   ```

2. Emitted the audit line immediately after the owner is persisted (so the generated `id`, along with the already-assigned `customerCode` and adjusted `registrationDate`, are all populated):
   ```java
   this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
   AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
       owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
   ```

This satisfies `Cp21Tests`, which captures the `AUDIT` logger and asserts a single log line contains the owner id, customerCode, and registrationDate as substrings. The observed line was e.g. `AUDIT - Owner created: id=11 customerCode=TOW-SUR-0001 registrationDate=2026-08-12`. All 32 tests across the suite pass.
